interface CarouselItem {
  id: string
  content: ReactNode
  label?: string
}

interface CarouselProps {
  items: CarouselItem[]
  loop?: boolean
  disabled?: boolean
  orientation?: 'horizontal' | 'vertical'
  direction?: 'ltr' | 'rtl'
  onValueChange?: (index: number) => void
  className?: string
  'aria-label': string
}

function Carousel({
  items,
  loop = false,
  disabled = false,
  orientation = 'horizontal',
  direction = 'ltr',
  onValueChange,
  className,
  'aria-label': label,
